review: parent-local sequential review of the repair experiment; no external code review
findings_resolved: Initial clearance draft measured as shorts; retained unscored, replaced with native-confirmed clearance-only seed.
Fixture selection rejects unknown starts and changed bytes before copying.
Repair audit is additive to full wire/action audit and independent final board validation.
Initial defect IDs must be visible and later resolved; merely ending on a valid board cannot satisfy repair audit.
limits: Three seeded cases, no held-out generalization or feedback ablation.
An agent may replace both routes; minimal edits are measured, not required.
Scripted repairs are withheld from model inputs.

post_run_verification.diagram: native coordinates and widths, XML checked and Quick Look previews inspected
